openmp.rule: time-weighted mean >= 0.95 (all blocks and L8 blocks)

fingerprint_bytes.rule: one value per fingerprint key (idx logs and checkpoints)

non_own.rule: |a - b| <= max(0.1 x max(a, b), 2000000 bytes), both; size ratio > 10

fit_rchar_on_staged_bytes.note: slope near 1: the reading process alone is counted (/proc/self/io); near 2: child reads would be counted

a_orc_13.own_bytes_model: tasks file + blocks file + the group's sobol.bin + per committed block the inventory lengths of its distinct graphs and len(json.dumps(native)) (estimate) + the checkpoint file of each block already present

a_orc_5.rule: (native max_rss_kb + Python ru_maxrss_self_kb) x 1024 / est_peak_bytes <= 1.2 for every index
